title: Button
summary: A button in five variants and three sizes, with busy, icon-only and toggle forms. type="submit" and "reset" act on the surrounding form, as a native button does. With href it renders a real link that looks like a button.

props.name: size
props.description: md is the reading-size control; mini is the compact desktop-density one; lg is the large one.

props.name: type
props.description: What a click does inside a form: nothing, submit it, or reset it.

props.name: href
props.description: Makes the button a link: the control is an <a> that navigates natively (middle and ctrl-click, the status-bar URL). Every variant, size, icon and busy style still applies. A link ignores type, toggle and pressed.

props.name: target
props.description: Where a link opens (for example _blank). Only with href.

props.name: rel
props.description: The link relation. Defaults to noopener when target is _blank. Only with href.

props.name: download
props.description: Downloads the target instead of opening it, under the file name given (the bare attribute keeps the name from the URL). Only with href.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and dims the control. Also set by a disabled fieldset. A disabled link loses its href and reports aria-disabled.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name, for a button whose visible content is only an icon. It wins over the words in the slot; leave it off and write the name as the button text with icon set instead.

props.name: busy
props.description: Shows a spinner and ignores clicks without disabling the button, so focus stays put. A busy link loses its href, reports aria-disabled and stays focusable.

props.name: block
props.description: Fills the width of its container.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon-only mode: a square button that draws only its icon (icon-name, a pk-icon or an svg in the start slot). The words in the default slot are hidden visually but stay the accessible name, and show as the tooltip on hover. The label prop wins over them when both are given.

props.name: iconName
props.description: Draws that symbol of the SDK icon sprite inside the control, before the label (the pk-icon names: plus, search, chevron-left and so on), so an icon button needs no child element. A name that is not in the sprite is reported once through the logger and nothing is drawn.

props.name: toggle
props.description: A button that stays pressed: a click flips pressed.

props.name: pressed
props.description: The pressed state of a toggle button.

slots.description: The label. With icon set it is hidden visually and kept as the accessible name; an element in it (a pk-icon) stays drawn.

events.name: click
events.description: A click (not fired while disabled or busy). A link fires it too, so a host can track the navigation; preventDefault stops the navigation.

events.name: pk-toggle
events.description: A toggle button was pressed or released.

parts.name: control
parts.description: The inner button element, or the anchor when href is set.

cssProperties.name: --pk-button-radius
cssProperties.description: Corner radius (a button group sets it to join its buttons).

methods.name: focus()
methods.description: Focuses the inner button or link.

a11y: A native button (with href a native link) lives in the shadow root, so it is focusable and exposes the button (link) role. A button activates on Enter and Space, a link on Enter only, as any link does; its name comes from the slot. An icon button (icon) hides that text visually (a zero-size font, not display:none, so it stays in the accessibility tree) and it remains the name; label overrides it. Every icon-only button needs a name: from its text, label or aria-label (the scorecard flags one without). The name is also the native title tooltip on hover (skipped inside a pk-tooltip, which gives hover and keyboard focus, or when the host has its own title); the title is never the name. A toggle reports aria-pressed; a busy button reports aria-busy and ignores clicks without dropping focus, and a busy icon button swaps its icon for the spinner and keeps its name; a disabled or busy link drops its href and reports aria-disabled. Focus ring and the 44px phone target are built in.

examples.title: Sizes, block and disabled
examples.html:
<pk-button size="lg">Large</pk-button>
<pk-button size="mini">Edit</pk-button>
<pk-button disabled>Locked</pk-button>
<pk-button block variant="secondary">Full width</pk-button>

examples.title: Busy, icon and toggle
examples.html:
<pk-button busy busy-text="Saving...">Save</pk-button>
<pk-button icon variant="ghost" label="Add"><svg slot="start" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg></pk-button>
<pk-button toggle variant="ghost" pressed>Bold</pk-button>

examples.title: Icon buttons: the text is the name
examples.html:
<pk-button icon variant="ghost" icon-name="plus">Add item</pk-button>
<pk-button icon variant="ghost" href="#orders"><pk-icon name="chevron-left"></pk-icon>Back to Orders</pk-button>
<pk-button icon variant="secondary" icon-name="search" busy>Search</pk-button>
<pk-button icon variant="ghost" icon-name="menu" toggle pressed>Menu</pk-button>
<pk-button icon size="mini" variant="plain" icon-name="x">Close</pk-button>
<pk-tooltip text="Add item"><pk-button icon icon-name="plus">Add item</pk-button></pk-tooltip>

examples.title: A link that looks like a button
examples.html:
<pk-button href="/reports">Open reports</pk-button>
<pk-button href="https://example.com/help" target="_blank" rel="noopener" variant="secondary">Help</pk-button>
<pk-button href="/export.csv" download="export.csv" variant="ghost">Download</pk-button>
<pk-button href="/reports" disabled>Unavailable</pk-button>
